Claude Fable 5.1.description: Anthropic's most capable model for demanding reasoning and long-horizon agent work. It has a one-million-token context window, up to 128K output tokens, and adaptive thinking that is always on.

Claude Opus 5.5.description: Anthropic's recommended starting point for most workloads, including long-running agentic coding and knowledge work. It is the Claude Code default. It has a one-million-token context window, up to 128K output tokens, and adaptive thinking that is always on.
features: Anthropic's starting point for most workloads
Fast mode available at $8 and $40 per million tokens

Claude Opus 5.description: Anthropic's previous Opus model. It remains active, but Claude Opus 5.5 costs less and is the better choice for new work.
features: Migrate to Claude Opus 5.5 for new work

Claude Sonnet 5.5.description: Anthropic's best combination of speed and intelligence for day-to-day agents, coding, writing, and interactive work. Select a model alias or exact ID when reproducibility matters.
features: Fast and capable for daily work
Good for expressive writing and iteration

Claude Haiku 5.5.description: Anthropic's fastest and cheapest model for high-volume, cost-sensitive tasks like classification, extraction, and quick questions. The price rises for prompts over 100K tokens.
features: Good for subagents and bulk steps

Gemini 4 Argon.description: Google's highest-capability generally available Gemini model, for difficult multimodal and long-context work. It has a one-million-token context window and no free tier. The introductory price ends on November 30, 2026.

Gemini 3.8 Flash.description: Google's current Flash workhorse for coding and agents. It has a free tier on the Gemini API. The introductory price ends on December 31, 2026.

Gemini 3.6 Flash.description: Google's previous stable Flash model. It remains useful for qualified production integrations, but Gemini 3.8 Flash is the recommendation for new coding and agent work.
features: Strong multimodal input and tool use
Good for interactive agents and high-throughput workflows

Gemini 3.5 Flash-Lite.description: Google's cheapest stable Gemini tier. Flash-Lite keeps a long context window, which fits high-volume agent calls and cost-sensitive background automation.

Gemini Omni Flash.description: Google's video model for generation, editing, keyframe interpolation, and extension with native audio. The API ID is gemini-omni-1.1-flash. Google's Veo preview models shut down on October 22, 2026, and point to this model.

Gemini 2.5 Pro (legacy).description: Google's deprecated Gemini 2.5 Pro model. Google routes it to Gemini 3.8 Flash on December 1, 2026. Move new and existing work to Gemini 3.8 Flash or Gemini 4 Argon.

Gemini 2.5 Flash (legacy).description: Google's deprecated Gemini 2.5 Flash model. Google routes it to a current Flash tier on December 1, 2026. Move new and existing work to Gemini 3.8 Flash or Gemini 3.5 Flash-Lite.

GPT-6 Astra.description: OpenAI's highest-intelligence model, for the most difficult reasoning and agent work. Use it when GPT-6.1 Sol does not meet the bar and the higher price is justified.
features: Available in the API and supported Codex plans
Best kept for the hardest work and independent review

GPT-6.1 Sol.description: OpenAI's recommended model for most complex work, with near-Astra capability at a lower price. It is the Codex default. Effort runs from low to max, and the default is medium.

GPT-6.1 Terra.description: OpenAI's fast tier for capable everyday work, with strong visual reasoning, computer use, and writing. Effort runs from none to max.
features: Works in Codex CLI 0.159.0 or later

GPT-6 Luna.description: OpenAI's fastest and most economical tier for routine work, high-volume tasks, and responsive applications. It is the Codex model on ChatGPT Free and Go, in the desktop app only.
features: Good for bulk and routine steps

Codex (GPT-6.1 Sol).description: OpenAI's coding agent, in the ChatGPT desktop app, mobile, web, CLI, IDE extension, and cloud. It uses GPT-6.1 Sol at medium effort by default. Cloud tasks run in isolated containers, so a long job keeps working after you close the laptop. Use a short AGENTS.md, a clear done-when check, and the smallest permissions that work.
features: Default model is GPT-6.1 Sol at medium effort
Also runs GPT-6 Astra, GPT-6.1 Terra, and GPT-6 Luna, depending on your plan
Local CLI and IDE work plus cloud tasks
codex exec for scripts, read-only by default
Automatic GitHub code review on supported plans

Nano Banana 2.1.description: Google's current all-around image model. The API ID is gemini-nano-banana-2.1. It improves visual quality, typography, and multi-turn consistency.

NotebookLM.description: Google's research and writing assistant that is grounded in your chosen source documents. It helps you get summaries, ask questions, and generate ideas based only on the material you provide, reducing hallucinations.
features: Generates summaries, FAQs, and audio overviews
Excellent for analyzing collections of documents

Grok 4.7.description: SpaceXAI's current frontier model, with a 500K-token context window. Current web or X information requires the Web Search or X Search tool. The base model is not real-time.
features: Web Search and X Search tools
Live data only with search tools on

Perplexity.description: Perplexity's search-grounded answer service. Perplexity ended Sonar Chat Completions support on September 27, 2026 and points new projects to its Agent API. Check the current Agent API models before you build on it.
features: Provides answers with inline source citations
Useful for source discovery and initial research
Verify cited primary sources before publication

Open-weight models.description: A category of models whose weights are available for local or private deployment. Licenses differ, and open weights do not always mean open source. Check each model's license, hardware needs, and safety controls before use.
features: Can run on local hardware (via Ollama, LM Studio, vLLM)
Current options include Kimi K3, GLM-5.3, DeepSeek V4, Qwen, MiniMax M3, Mistral, StepFun, MiMo, Hy3, Command A+, Nemotron 3 Ultra, and Llama 4
No per-token costs once running locally

GLM-5.3 (open weights).description: Z.ai's model for long-horizon agent work, with a one-million-token context window and open weights under the GLM-5.3 License. That license adds a security-review term for large model-service businesses. GLM-5.3-Flash and FlashX are the cheaper hosted tiers. Benchmark it on your own workload.
features: GLM-5.3 License: read it before you self-host

Qwen 3.7 Plus.description: Alibaba Cloud's current hosted Qwen Plus tier for long-context agents and multimodal knowledge work. The moving alias currently provides a one-million-token context window.

Qwen 3.8 Max.description: Alibaba Cloud's top hosted Qwen tier for complex reasoning work. Check the Model Studio catalog for regional availability before production use.
features: Reasoning, text generation, and agent workflows

Qwen3.6-35B-A3B (open weights).description: Alibaba's open-weight mixture-of-experts model with 35B total and about 3B active parameters. It is a practical efficiency-oriented option for local agentic coding and general tool use.
features: Good for IDE autocomplete and refactoring

DeepSeek V4 (open weights).description: DeepSeek V4 Pro is an MIT-licensed open-weight model with one-million-token context. The API also offers V4.1 Flash as deepseek-flash, with text and image input. V4 Flash is retired on the API. Confirm the V4.1 Flash license before you self-host.
features: V4 Pro and V4.1 Flash variants
Open weights and hosted API options

Kimi K3 (open weights).description: Moonshot AI's open-weight flagship for long-horizon coding, visual understanding, and knowledge work, released under the Kimi K3 License. The hosted Kimi K3.1 Pro and Highspeed tiers have a one-million-token context window.
features: Custom Kimi K3 License requires use-case review

MiniMax M3.description: MiniMax's open-weight coding and agent model with multimodal input and up to one million tokens of context. The weights use the MiniMax Community License. MiniMax M3.1 Flash is the hosted fast tier.

Mistral Large 4 (open weights).description: Mistral's frontier multimodal model for agent and coding work, released under the Mistral Ecosystem Open Weight License. Read the license before private deployment.

NVIDIA Nemotron 3 Ultra (open weights).description: NVIDIA's open model for long-running agent orchestration. It uses a 550B-parameter mixture-of-experts design with 55B active parameters and supports up to one million tokens of context.
features: Open weights, recipes, and deployment tooling

Mistral Small 4 (open weights).description: Mistral's efficient hybrid model for instruction following, reasoning, and coding. It supports a 256K context window and uses the Apache 2.0 license.
features: Unified instruct, reasoning, and coding modes

Step-3.7-Flash (open weights).description: StepFun's current efficient agentic model. It targets coding, tool use, and research workflows and is released under the Apache 2.0 license.

MiMo-V2-Flash (open weights).description: Xiaomi's efficient reasoning, coding, and agent model. It has 309B total parameters, 15B active parameters, and a 256K context window.

Tencent Hy3 (open weights).description: Tencent Hunyuan's efficient reasoning and agent model. The released Hy3 family uses a mixture-of-experts design with 295B total and 21B active parameters.
features: Benchmark on the target inference stack

Cohere Command A+ (open weights).description: Cohere's current multimodal enterprise agent model. It supports reasoning, tool use, translation across 48 languages, 128K context, and private deployment under Apache 2.0.

Llama 4 Scout / Maverick (open weights).description: Meta's latest released Llama language-model family. Scout prioritizes efficient deployment and very long context; Maverick provides the stronger general-purpose multimodal tier.
features: Scout supports up to 10M input tokens
Maverick is the higher-capability released tier

ERNIE 5.1.description: Baidu's current ERNIE general model, released in May 2026. It focuses on writing, understanding, reasoning, and agent tasks in Baidu's hosted products.

ByteDance Seed2.0.description: ByteDance's current general multimodal and agent model family. Seed2.0 Pro and Code are available in Doubao and TRAE, with APIs through Volcano Engine.

ElevenLabs.description: ElevenLabs provides speech, transcription, sound, and music models. Eleven v4 is the flagship creative speech model, v4 Turbo is the fast choice, Realtime v1 serves voice agents, and Scribe v2 handles transcription.
features: Eleven v4 expressive speech and multi-speaker dialogue
Scribe v2 and Scribe v2 Realtime for transcription
Music v2 for prompted music generation
Voice cloning requires consent and policy checks

Midjourney.description: Midjourney's newest image model is V8.2, released July 24, 2026. V8.1 became the default in June; V8.2 improves aesthetics, image quality, and personalization.
features: Review editorial disclosure and synthetic-media policy before publication

Qwen 3.8 Flash.description: Alibaba Cloud's fast hosted Qwen tier for high-volume and responsive work.
